options.name: api_token
options.description: Nextcloud App Password. Can also be set as ENV variable.

options.name: delete_recursively
options.description: Whether a target is deleted recursively. Necessary for folders.

options.name: destination
options.description: When the mode is get, destination will the location of the downloaded file. When the mode is put, destination describes the file location on nextcloud. When the mode is delete, destination is not required.

options.name: host
options.description: Nextcloud tld host. Can also be set as ENV variable.

options.name: mode
options.description: Weather the file should be downloaded (get), uploaded (put) or deleted (delete).

options.name: overwrite
options.description: Force overwrite locally on the filesystem Used only with GET parameter. one of [always, never, different, different_size]. C(different) depends on sha256sum an is made C(in memory) for remote files.

options.name: source
options.description: When the mode is get or delete, source describes the file location on nextcloud. When the mode is put, source describes the origin file location which will be uploaded to nextcloud.

options.name: ssl_mode
options.description: ability to use http:// for integration tests ability to skip ssl verification Possible values `https` (default https), `http` (http), `skip` (https)

options.name: user
options.description: Nextcloud user who (will) owns the file. Can also be set as ENV variable.
